conditional.text: At the beginning you said it matters to you not to harm others through your actions.
At the beginning you said that when you realize you're doing something harmful to others, you look for how to change that.
At the beginning you said that when you learn a truth that would require you to change your relationship with your surroundings, you consider it important to face it even if it's uncomfortable.
At the beginning you said you would have been against major injustices when they were actually happening. This injustice is still happening.

text: Are you ready to align your behavior with your beliefs and stop exploiting animals?
That means not consuming or using meat, milk, eggs, leather, and the rest — in other words, not treating animals as a resource.
